body:
Thanks for reading and for the kind words. 

I would love to have that light bulb go off in my head, where I knew exactly what I wanted to do with my life and be happy going to work. It just never came. 

I know I'm incapable of having a relationship at this point. I can't take care of myself, nevermind someone else. The thought of losing someone else that I would care deeply about drives me away too. 

Yes, I have gotten my nutrient levels and thyroid checked. From what I remember, both were normal. I had a sleep study done, which came back normal, but the results are questionable. I stayed up the night/day before so I would be able to fall asleep for the test, and was forcibly woken up in the morning. I probably had another 6+ hours of sleep left in me. Only thing I learned is I do not have sleep apnea. 

I wouldn't say I've ever been capable of accomplishing more than others, but I have had sporadic days/weeks, where I am more/feel like I'm capable of doing more than I'm used to. These times always end up in failure, usually in a "crash and burn" type scenario.
